ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a structural schematic diagram of a plant, with the main stem extending upward, leaves and lateral branches distributed on both sides of the stem, and the roots in the soil. Multiple letter labels in the image point to different parts of the plant with horizontal lines or indicating lines. At the very top of the main stem there is a small bud-like structure, and on the right side there is an indicating line pointing to this very top position, labeled F. Reasoning: The question asks about the terminal bud, that is, the apical bud. The apical bud is located at the very top of the main stem. The label in the image that points to the bud at the top of the main stem is F, therefore the answer is F.
